name: Coconut Toffee
subtitle: coconut and milk boiled to a fudge, cut in diamonds at Christmas
prepNotes: This is the Anglo-Indian Christmas sweet, made alongside kul kuls and rose cookies and given away in tins.
It is a sugar-stage recipe. Stop at the wrong moment and you get either syrup or a brick.

steps.text: Boil the sugar and milk together until the sugar dissolves completely.
Add the coconut and cook on medium, stirring constantly, for 20 minutes.
steps.tip: Constantly. The bottom catches the moment you look away.

steps.text: Add the butter and cardamom and keep going until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan in one mass and a drop set in cold water holds its shape.
Pour into a greased tray, scatter the cashew and press down flat.
Mark into diamonds while still warm and cut through when cold.
steps.tip: Mark warm, cut cold. Cutting it hot smears it; cutting it fully cold shatters it.

storage: Keeps 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature. It dries out slowly rather than spoiling, so eat it while it still yields.
